name: DeepVerify real-source pilot
status: unpopulated candidate specification; no collected or approved cases
language_scope: English-language assertions and publicly accessible English source text
geographic_scope: Aim for UK, US, India, EU and global/multilateral coverage; record actual scope rather than claiming geographic representativeness
selection_protocol: A human curator supplies actual candidate assertions, temporal context and topic/group identifiers before collection.
Sampling tags are hypotheses for coverage, never completed ground-truth labels.
Use one independent claim group per plan entry; put paraphrases and historical variants in the same group.
Do not select or delete cases based on whether the model succeeds; preserve failed searches and extraction outcomes.
Include official primary sources and independently reported secondary sources when the provider returns them.
Inspect duplicate/syndicated source groups before freezing; do not treat copies as independent support.
Double-review at least 20 percent of collected claim groups and explicitly adjudicate every required label.
biases: Convenience pilot, not statistically representative; 60 groups is a collection target, not proof of adequacy.
English/public-web and search-ranking bias; paywalled, script-only, local-language and poorly indexed evidence may be missing.
Geographic, topic and reviewer selection biases must be reported with actual collected counts.
Reranking metrics cover a bounded retrieved pool, not total search recall or population factual accuracy.
